entry.author: 1News
entry.summary:
This week’s ASB Good as Gold recipient is Flow Waaka of Christchurch. 

Initially featured on a segment on Seven Sharp, Flow’s inspirational work garnered nominations from Kiwis nationwide, leading to her recognition as an ASB Good as Gold recipient. Flow has been tirelessly feeding the homeless and low-income individuals twice a week for over a decade. Alongside her dedicated team, she prepares and serves meals, and provides essential items like gloves, beanies, socks, blankets, and sleeping bags. She utilizes her social media platforms to raise awareness, funds, and to seek assistance. Her charitable efforts have even helped two individuals acquire cars. Flow is celebrated for her respect, passion, kindness, selflessness, and unwavering commitment. 

ASB is honoured to acknowledge Flow Waaka’s remarkable contributions with $10,000 as this week’s ASB Good as Gold recipient.
